info.title: dlpapi
info.description: Easily and directly scan and detect sensitive data (PII) in input text.

post.summary: Detect User Data in Input Text
post.description: Detects configurable types of user data in an input text string using Advanced AI.

post.summary: Detect User Data in Input Text (Advanced)
post.description: Detects 29 configurable types of user data including health-related PHI in an input text string using Advanced AI.

post.summary: Detect User Data in Document Image (Advanced)
post.description: Detects 29 configurable types of user data including health-related PHI in a document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, HTML, EML, MSG, PNG, JPG, WEBP) using Advanced AI.

post.summary: Detect User Data in Document Image
post.description: Detects configurable types of user data in a document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, HTML, EML, MSG, PNG, JPG, WEBP) using Advanced AI.

post.summary: Detect User Data in Audio File
post.description: Transcribes an audio file (WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, WMA) and detects 23 configurable types of user data in the transcript using Advanced AI. Returns the full transcript, token timestamps, and detection results.

post.summary: Detect User Data in Audio File (Advanced)
post.description: Transcribes an audio file (WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, WMA) and detects 29 configurable types of user data including health-related PHI in the transcript using Advanced AI. Returns the full transcript, token timestamps, detection results, and optional rationale.

post.summary: Redact User Data in Input Text
post.description: Detects and redacts configurable types of user data in an input text string using Advanced AI. First detects PII, then redacts disallowed types by either deleting them or replacing them with asterisks.

post.summary: Redact User Data in Input Text (Advanced)
post.description: Detects and redacts 34 configurable types of user data including health-related PHI in an input text string using Advanced AI. First detects PII, then redacts disallowed types by either deleting them or replacing them with asterisks.

Detects and redacts configurable types of user data in a document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, HTML, EML, MSG, PNG, JPG, WEBP) using Advanced AI. Rasterizes document pages, detects PII regions using a grid-overlay approach, blurs those regions, and returns a rasterized PDF.

Detects and redacts 35 configurable types of user data including health-related PHI in a document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, HTML, EML, MSG, PNG, JPG, WEBP) using Advanced AI. Rasterizes document pages, detects PII regions using a row-overlay approach, redacts those regions, and returns a rasterized PDF.

post.summary: Redact User Data in Audio File
post.description: Transcribes an audio file (WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG, WMA), detects 23 configurable types of user data in the transcript, and redacts audio segments containing PII. Returns the redacted audio, redacted transcript, detection results, and redacted segment timestamps.

CustomPiiField.description:
Caller-defined custom PII field. The redaction LLM will look for content matching
the description and redact it as a semantic tag derived from the title
(e.g. title "internal participant code" → tag [INTERNAL-PARTICIPANT-CODE]).

Title.description: Short title for the custom field, also used to derive the semantic tag (uppercased, spaces/underscores replaced with hyphens).

CustomFields.description:
Optional list of caller-defined custom PII fields to detect and redact in addition
to the built-in categories. Each entry has a Title (used to derive the redaction
tag, e.g. "internal participant code" → [INTERNAL-PARTICIPANT-CODE]) and a
Description telling the redaction LLM what the field looks like. Default null.

ExpandRedactionByCharacters.description:
Optional override for the audio bleep/mute span padding. When set, expands each
detected redaction range by this many CHARACTERS on each side before mapping to
audio tokens (instead of the default token-radius expansion controlled by the
DlpApi_Audio_ExpandRedactionByTokenRadius cloud configuration). Leave null to
use the default token-radius behavior.

ExpandRedactionByMs.description:
Optional override for the audio bleep/mute span padding, expressed in MILLISECONDS.
When set, the audio segment for each detected redaction starts this many ms earlier
and ends this many ms later than the raw token-aligned span (clamped to >= 0 ms at
the start). When set, this REPLACES both the token-radius expansion and the
ExpandRedactionByCharacters override. Leave null to fall back to the character or
token-based expansion modes.

SpeechRecognitionMode.description: Optional. Speech recognition mode used when transcribing the audio for redaction. Available values: "Fast", "Normal", or "Advanced". Defaults to "Normal" when not specified.
